title: Copilot Notebooks: JPG and PNG files as knowledge sources
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents preview automation for the Notebooks creation policy, contrary to the table's automation gap. The briefing also overstates that policy as switching Notebooks off completely and calls it the only documented control, although existing items can remain accessible and Microsoft documents other governance controls.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The documentation does not separately describe where a newly added image reference is stored.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot Notebooks image references stored uploaded files OneDrive JPG PNG retention'; opened cpcn-admin-configuration, cpcn-requirements and cpcn-storage. They describe files and notebook storage generally, not new image-reference ingestion.

claims.claim: The Notebooks storage and requirements pages do not describe storage accounting specifically for image references.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot Notebooks JPG PNG references licensing price meter storage retention sensitivity labels'; read cpcn-storage and cpcn-requirements. General notebook quotas are described; separate image-reference accounting is not.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented automation for the Cloud Policy Notebooks creation setting.
claims.quote: These resources also support remediation and applyOnce. ... The 20 Copilot resources are Office Cloud Policy Service (OCPS) settings. ... Controls whether users can create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks
claims.fix: Set controls[0].api to kind graph, call 'POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors', docs https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/configurationmanagement-post-configurationmonitors?view=graph-rest-beta. Add to the note: 'Preview TCM applyOnce: set mode to applyOnce and baseline.resources resourceType to microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks, resourceVersion 1, properties.value to string 0 (disable) or 1 (enable). Tenant-level policies only; any group-level configuration of this setting causes failure. The calling app needs delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All, the TCM service principal delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite, and the signed-in user AI Administrator. Beta APIs are not supported for production use.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources and https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-remediation-applyonce-resources.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: The creation policy is the only Notebooks control documented on Learn.
claims.quote: Retention policies from Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management configured for all SharePoint sites are enforced for all Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks. ... Data Loss Prevention (DLP): Rules enforced with end-user policy tip support.
claims.fix: Replace both exclusivity statements with: 'The documented Cloud Policy setting governs Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation and integration.' Do not call it the only documented Notebooks control.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: The creation policy switches Notebooks on or off as a whole rather than selecting image file types.
claims.quote: When creation is disabled, users are unable to create new Copilot Pages or Notebooks. ... Existing Copilot Pages and Notebooks aren't deleted. Users can still view and edit existing items if they have permission.
claims.fix: Replace 'switches Notebooks on or off' and 'Governs Notebooks as a whole' with 'governs creation and integration, not all access to existing items'. Retain the documented existing-item access explanation and the separate image-control gap.

claims.claim: The roadmap and supplied notice describe image grounding and do not announce autonomous actions.
claims.quote: Copilot can use the content within these images, including text, charts, diagrams, and other visuals, as grounding context to help generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

claims.claim: The creation policy does not distinguish file types and does not provide an option to allow documents while excluding image references.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot Notebooks JPG PNG references admin image reasoning policy switch'; read cpcn-admin-configuration and utcm-copilot-resources. The creation policy has enabled/disabled states, not file-type choices.
